One plan-delta: is_scale_authorized requires overall==PASS (an owner APPROVE is recordable to demonstrate the CTR-026 transition, but no scale is authorized in the fail-closed staged posture). STATUS is coder SELF-REPORTED (not a gate/judge sign-off, RULE-015); the runner gate + JUDGE decide, and the M6.2G exit gate M6-P1609 checks both legs (no auto scale; owner approval required). No self-certification of the ledger; module boundary intact (no pricing/order-state/commission/CRM); no raw secrets or unmasked PII in code/notes/evidence; FAIL-006 not tripped (the slice never acts).
